propositions: The reconciler re-attempts the same structurally-impossible inbound (Jira → rebar) link ADDs on every pass because failed links never land LINK events and are re-emitted identically by the differ.

The applier catches exceptions from rebar.link, logs a WARNING, and continues with no memory of the failure, so the same 19 doomed writes recur ~every 5–6 min indefinitely (200+ failed writes per hour).

Three permanent failure shapes (closed source, redundant ancestor-descendant, would create cycle) are deterministic verdicts from local graph state, not transient I/O faults, so they re-raise identically until the structure changes.

The fix records permanently-impossible link ADDs durably to impossible_links.json with a deciding digest over the endpoints' status, parent chain, and dep set, and skips the write when the digest still matches.

A cycle record keys on the global structural projection (every ticket's status/parent/deps) because add_dependency walks the transitive graph, so an intermediate ticket's change can break the cycle even though both endpoints are unchanged.

The impossible_links.json file must be committed to the tickets branch by _commit_binding_store_snapshot; a record living only in the working tree would be discarded between CI passes and the fix would silently fail in production.
